text:
Ava: Quick idea 
I drafted a one-pager aimed at security-conscious buyers that compares Hosted / Dedicated / Private in a single column flow. Need super-short bullets for sales. Link: https://docs.google.com/onepager-internal
Tom: Love it. Can we add a 3-line "When to pick" for each mode? e.g., Hosted = speed of launch, Dedicated = predictable throughput & SLA, Private = full control & air-gap.
Rhea: Add compliance checklist: KMS/HSM, SOC2 Type II, audit logs retention policy. Keep plain language.
Omar: Benchmarks request: p95 latency (short chats) and a simple cost delta line vs Hosted. One sentence per mode.
Ava: Done. I also added a tiny ops flow for failover: if region outage -> route to fallback pool with compatible model; canary policy included.
Tom: Can you paste the canary snippet inline? Sales likes to show a config example.
Ava: ```yaml
canary:
  rollout_percent: 10
  watch_window: 30m
  fallback_on_error: true
```
Rhea: Wording tweak: say "near-identical SLA" for fallback to be safe. Also added an escalation path line: "File support ticket -> 1hr response SLA for P1"
Omar: I'll flatten the benchmark numbers from our 50k/day finserv sample into a single sentence.
Ava: Great. CTA suggestion: "Schedule a 20-minute field demo" + checkbox for Dedicated trial qualification.
deploy-bot: Note: doc updated by Ava 5 minutes ago
Ava: Final draft will land on Thursday AM. Can folks give final thumbs by Wed EOD? :thumbsup:
